job.title: [Post] Hiring: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer(W2 Only) Location: 100% Remote (Preference for…

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Headless & PWA Commerce APIs | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] Hiring: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer(W2 Only)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in your remote e-commerce development opportunity. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in backend architecture, headless APIs, and complex integrations.

bullets.label: Headless & API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized robust data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Platform Customization
bullets.text: Maintained and extended core promotion engines, FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts, and Order Management systems within high-traffic enterprise environments.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners and international stakeholders, translated them into functional solutions, and supported user acceptance testing.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, hold a valid residence and work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am currently serving a notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise aligns with your team's needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend development expertise to your remote initiatives. Having built, extended, and integrated large-scale platforms for global industry leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring proven skills in headless APIs, robust data pipelines, and techno-functional delivery to drive high-performing digital commerce solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, headless API development, and robust integration expertise to drive high-performing digital platforms remotely.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and headless API experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in your remote developer opportunity. I hold a valid German work permit and am available from 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and integrating enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in backend engineering, headless APIs, and techno-functional delivery.

I am based in Germany with a valid work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your remote team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
